minor.issue: days=0 returns days=30 (default) instead of the specified clamp to 1, because of `int(days or 30)` (0 is falsy). days=-5 -> 1, days=9999 -> 365 work as specified. Cosmetic only.

Transient: during the first pytest run two consecutive requests hit a 60s read timeout (~120s block), while a 40x/3s probe loop and curl always answered in ~0.2s. Suggests the event loop was blocked by another task (scan/backfill) at that moment - worth watching, not reproducible on demand.
